meta.name: Offline Music Player — UI reference
meta.device: iPod touch 7th gen, 320×568 pt, iOS 15, home button, portrait
meta.purpose: Visual and behavioral reference for implementing the SwiftUI app in the engineering spec. Not production code. Do not embed or port this HTML; map it to native SwiftUI/UIKit.
meta.precedence: The engineering spec (Offline Music Player — Final Product & Engineering Specification v1.0) wins over this document wherever they differ.

tokens.note: Hex/rgba values are those used in the prototype. Implement with the named semantic colors, not hex. The semantic mapping is from memory of Apple’s published values — verify in Xcode.
colors: secondarySystemFill (search field, slider track, active pill)
system tab/navigation bar appearance — do not customize
typography: Nav title / button label / primary text
tokens.typographyNote: The prototype uses fixed px for layout fidelity. The app must use Dynamic Type text styles and let row heights grow (minHeight, not fixed height).

metrics: 44 pt (+ large title ≈ 52 pt when expanded)
48 pt, directly above the tab bar
138 pt wide, 2 columns, 12 pt column gap, 14 pt row gap, 16 pt side margins
≤ 240 pt, square, flexes with height; 88% scale when paused
44 × 44 pt (ellipsis buttons are 36 × 44 in the prototype — enlarge)
Artwork 4–8 pt; grouped lists 10 pt; buttons 10–12 pt; sheets 12 pt
symbolsNote: Prototype icons are inline-SVG approximations. Symbol names above are best-effort; confirm each exists on iOS 15 in the SF Symbols app (not verified here).
components: Artwork 36, title, play/pause, next; tap → Now Playing

No public SwiftUI tab-bar accessory API on iOS 15 as far as I know (verify). Options: overlay above the measured tab-bar height (49 pt), or a UITabBarController-based container. Must persist across pushes in every tab.
Large title on tab roots; inline title + back label on pushed screens
artwork 40, title, artist, ellipsis menu, swipe Play Next
folder.fill, name, “N songs” or status, chevron, context menu
4 pt track, elapsed/remaining labels, drag to seek
Custom (SwiftUI Slider can’t be restyled thin on iOS 15); needs accessibility value + adjustable action
.alert / .contextMenu / Menu; text-field alert needs a UIKit bridge on iOS 15
navigation: Library Statistics / Playback Preferences / Supported Audio Formats
coverage: Folder picker in the interactive prototype is a mock
Use UIDocumentPickerViewController; it cannot be restyled. Persist the bookmark, then scan.
“Supported Audio Formats” is a static list
Spec §6 says validate by decoder playback. Populate from verified results (CODEC_SUPPORT.md); do not list FLAC/Ogg/Opus as supported unless verified.
Library Statistics, song counts, scan counters, sample catalog and lyrics are invented
Bind to real data; remove all sample content from the shipped app.
Spec §7: restore last track/position/queue without auto-playing. Confirm label and behavior.
Full-screen in the prototype for height; use fullScreenCover, or a card-style .sheet for system dismissal gestures.
See component table; verify on the 4-inch device.
Needs relativePath (or equivalent) per Track; not in the spec’s conceptual entities.
Up Next is tap-to-jump only. Reorder/remove not designed.
Should appear as a source row (e.g. “On My iPod touch › Music”); not drawn separately.
Dynamic Type accessibility sizes, VoiceOver, landscape
Not designed or tested. Prototype only has aria-labels on icon buttons.
Minimal (albums + songs) in the interactive prototype; not one of the 15 required screens.
HTML rendered in a desktop webview; nothing here proves iPod touch behavior, performance or API availability.

screens.title: Screen 1 — First launch / empty library
screens.swiftUI: NavigationView › empty-state VStack (Image(systemName:"folder.badge.plus") 64–72 pt, Text title2 bold, Text subheadline secondary, Button(.borderedProminent) “Add Music Folder”, Label footnote “Your music stays on your device.”). .navigationTitle("Library"), large display mode. Shown only when MusicSource count == 0.
screens.data: MusicSource: count == 0. No other fetches.
screens.states: empty (this frame). Tab bar and other tabs remain usable; Playlists/Search show their own empty states.
screens.actions: “Add Music Folder” → presents UIDocumentPickerViewController (system UI, not styleable) → on success persist security-scoped bookmark → create MusicSource → present Scan sheet (screen 15).
screens.notes: No account, login or subscription UI. No mini-player (no current track).

screens.title: Screen 2 — Library home
screens.swiftUI: NavigationView › List(.plain) with NavigationLink rows, then a “Recently Added” section: horizontal ScrollView { LazyHStack } of album tiles (112 pt artwork). .navigationTitle("Library") large. Mini-player + TabView are siblings (see component inventory).
screens.data: Static destination list. Recently Added: Album sorted by dateAdded desc, limit ≈ 5–10 (assumption: Album or Track needs a dateAdded attribute; the spec does not name one).
screens.states: populated (this frame); empty = screen 1; scanning shows partial results incrementally.
screens.actions: Songs / Albums / Artists / Genres / Folders / Recently Added rows push the respective screens. Tile tap → Album details. “See All” → Recently Added grid.
screens.notes: Row height 44 pt. Large title collapses to inline on scroll (standard NavigationView behavior).

screens.title: Screen 2 — Library home (light appearance)
screens.swiftUI: Same view as screen 2. Do not branch on colorScheme; use semantic colors so both appearances are automatic.
screens.notes: Required deliverable: Library and Now Playing in light appearance.

screens.title: Screen 3 — All Songs
screens.swiftUI: List(.plain) + search (.searchable or in-list field as drawn). Header rows: count + Menu for sort, then two Buttons (Play / Shuffle, .bordered). Row = HStack { artwork 40×40, VStack(title callout, artist footnote secondary), Spacer, Menu(ellipsis) }. Load thumbnails asynchronously from ArtworkCache.
screens.data: Track sorted by title (default), artist, album or dateAdded. Count = fetch count. The prototype shows a 38-song sample while the header says “1,434 Songs” (placeholder).
screens.states: populated; filtered (search); current track highlighted (accent-colored title); unavailable rows (see S1).
screens.actions: Row tap → PlaybackCoordinator.play(queue: songs in current order, startAt: track); mini-player appears; Now Playing opens from the mini-player. Ellipsis → context menu. Swipe left → Play Next (.swipeActions, iOS 15).
screens.notes: Tapping a song does NOT auto-open Now Playing (matches Apple Music). Row height 52 pt.

screens.title: Screen 3 — song ellipsis / context menu
screens.swiftUI: Menu { Button("Play Next", systemImage:"text.insert") … } or .contextMenu on the row with the same items: Play Next, Add to Playlist…, Go to Album, Add to Favorites.
screens.data: Play Next mutates the PlaybackCoordinator queue. Add to Favorites → Favorites playlist entry.
screens.actions: Go to Album → pushes Album details onto the current navigation stack.
screens.notes: Use the native menu; do not draw a custom popover.

screens.title: Screen 4 — Albums
screens.swiftUI: ScrollView { LazyVGrid(columns:[GridItem(.flexible(),spacing:12),GridItem(.flexible())], spacing:14) } with 16 pt horizontal padding. Tile = VStack(alignment:.leading){ square artwork radius 6, title subheadline semibold lineLimit(1), artist footnote secondary lineLimit(1) }.
screens.data: Album sorted by title (assumption). Group compilations by album artist (spec §5).
screens.actions: Tile tap → Album details.
screens.notes: Exactly 2 columns at 320 pt: tile width = (320 − 2×16 − 12) / 2 = 138 pt.

screens.title: Screen 5 — Album details
screens.swiftUI: List(.plain): header (artwork 148 pt centered, title, artist in accent color, “Genre · Year”, “N songs · M min”), Play/Shuffle row, then numbered ForEach(tracks). Number column 22 pt secondary; prototype shows duration under the title — a trailing duration is also fine.
screens.data: Album → tracks sorted by discNumber then trackNumber (spec §5). Artist link → Artist details.
screens.actions: Row tap → play album queue from that track. Artist name → Artist details.
screens.notes: Artwork 148 pt chosen for the 568 pt height; do not scale to full width.

screens.title: Screen 6 — Artists
screens.swiftUI: List(.plain) rows: circular 40 pt artwork (first album’s cover — NO online photos), name (body), “N Albums, M Songs” (footnote secondary), chevron. Optional alphabetical section index.
screens.data: Artist with album/track counts; use album artist where available.
screens.actions: Row tap → Artist details (albums + songs; not one of the 15 required screens).
screens.notes: Fallback artwork when none embedded: neutral SF Symbol on a fill background.

screens.title: Screen 7 — Folder browser (registered sources) with context menu
screens.swiftUI: List of registered MusicSource rows (folder.fill, name, “N songs”). Row .contextMenu { Button("Rescan Folder"); Button(role:.destructive){ "Remove from Library" } } with a confirmation alert. Nav bar trailing Button(systemImage:"folder.badge.plus") = Add Folder.
screens.data: MusicSource list. Subfolder hierarchy is derived from each Track’s path relative to its source (assumption: store relativePath on Track; the spec does not list it).
screens.states: populated; source unavailable / needs reconnect (see S1, S2).
screens.actions: Row tap → folder contents (07b). Add Folder → document picker. Remove → alert → removes index/source only, never files (spec §4).
screens.notes: Long-press in the prototype; native contextMenu in SwiftUI.

screens.title: Screen 7 — Folder contents → play
screens.swiftUI: Same List; subfolders as NavigationLinks, then Play/Shuffle and track rows for files directly in this folder.
screens.data: Tracks where source == X and relativePath has the folder prefix. The prototype maps albums to folders for demo only.
screens.actions: Track row → play, queue = tracks in this folder in listed order.
screens.notes: Back label shows the parent folder name.

screens.title: Screen 8 — Now Playing
screens.swiftUI: Present with .fullScreenCover (full height is needed at 568 pt; an iOS 15 .sheet is card-style). VStack: header (dismiss chevron.down, “NOW PLAYING” caption2 + context name footnote semibold, ellipsis Menu); artwork region fills remaining height, square, max 240 pt (shrink to 88% when paused); title + artist; favorite button; seek bar; elapsed/remaining labels; transport row (backward.fill, play/pause 46 pt, forward.fill); secondary row (shuffle, repeat/repeat.1, quote.bubble, list.bullet).
screens.data: PlaybackCoordinator (single instance): currentTrack, elapsed, duration, isPlaying, shuffle, repeat (off/all/one), queue. Views observe; they never own an engine.
screens.states: playing; paused (artwork scaled 0.88, shown here); no lyrics (button still present); unavailable-track error (S3).
screens.actions: Lyrics button → lyrics mode (09). Queue button → Up Next (08b). Dismiss → previous screen. Seek drag → coordinator.seek.
screens.notes: All controls fit in 320×568 without clipping. No volume slider (hardware buttons). Drive elapsed time from the engine’s time observer; keep timers off while paused.

screens.title: Screen 8 — Now Playing (light appearance)
screens.swiftUI: Same view; semantic colors only.
screens.notes: Required deliverable.

screens.title: Screen 8 — Up Next (queue mode)
screens.swiftUI: Replaces the artwork region with a compact header (artwork 44 pt, title, artist) and a List of upcoming tracks; transport controls stay. Add .onMove/.onDelete only if queue editing is implemented (spec requires play-next/add-to-queue; reorder UI is not specified).
screens.data: Queue order after the current item, wrapping per repeat mode.
screens.actions: Row tap → jump to that item.
screens.notes: Gap: queue reorder/remove UI is not designed.

screens.title: Screen 9 — Synchronized lyrics
screens.swiftUI: ScrollViewReader + ScrollView { LazyVStack } of lines; current line primary color, others ≈32% opacity; scrollTo(currentIndex, anchor: UnitPoint(x:0.5,y:0.32)); tap line → coordinator.seek(to: line.time). Manual scroll should pause auto-follow briefly. Controls below are the same as Now Playing.
screens.data: LyricsService returns [LyricLine(time: TimeInterval?, text)] from embedded tags or an adjacent .lrc (spec §8). The current line is derived from audio playback time, including seeks and pauses.
screens.actions: Tap line → seek. ✕ or compact header → back to artwork mode.
screens.notes: Lyric text here is invented placeholder text. Restrained animation only.

screens.title: Screen 9 — Plain (unsynchronized) lyrics
screens.swiftUI: Same scroll container; all lines primary color, no highlight, no tap-to-seek affordance. NEVER synthesize timestamps for plain lyrics (spec §8).
screens.data: Embedded plain lyrics string split on newlines.
screens.actions: None on lines.
screens.notes: Rendered by post-processing the synced frame.

screens.title: Screen 9 — Lyrics unavailable
screens.swiftUI: ContentUnavailableView does not exist on iOS 15; use a centered VStack (Image quote.bubble, headline, subheadline secondary).
screens.data: No embedded lyrics and no matching .lrc.
screens.notes: Adjust copy if plain lyrics are also absent.

screens.title: Screen 10 — Playlists
screens.swiftUI: List(.plain): first row “New Playlist…” (plus, accent), Favorites, user playlists, a section for imported M3U/M3U8. Row: 2×2 artwork collage or placeholder 48 pt, name, “N songs”. Nav trailing + Button also creates a playlist.
screens.data: Playlist (kind: favorites | user | imported). Imported playlists behave identically at playback time; the source file extension is a secondary hint (assumption).
screens.states: populated; empty (only “New Playlist…”); imported playlist with unresolved entries.
screens.actions: Row → Playlist details. New Playlist → name prompt (S5).
screens.notes: Collage: first 4 distinct album covers; repeat if fewer.

screens.title: Screen 11 — Playlist details
screens.swiftUI: Header (collage 148 pt, name, “N songs · M min”), Play/Shuffle, ForEach rows with .swipeActions(edge:.trailing){ Play Next; Remove } and .contextMenu. Nav trailing EditButton() toggling EditMode for .onDelete / .onMove.
screens.data: PlaylistEntry ordered; entries reference stable Track identities; duplicates preserved; missing tracks stay visible as unavailable (spec §9).
screens.actions: Row tap → play playlist queue from that entry. Remove deletes the entry only, never audio files.
screens.notes: Swipe actions are not visible in a static frame; they exist in the interactive prototype.

screens.title: Screen 11 — Editing / reorder
screens.swiftUI: Standard List edit mode: red delete control at left, reorder handle at right (system-provided via .onMove / .onDelete; do not hand-draw).
screens.data: Reordering rewrites PlaylistEntry order in a single batch.
screens.actions: Done exits edit mode.
screens.notes: Handles drawn here approximate the native control.

screens.title: Screen 12 — Search (before typing)
screens.swiftUI: .searchable(text:placement:.navigationBarDrawer(displayMode:.always)) on a NavigationView root. Empty state VStack as drawn. No suggestions, trending or recommendations.
screens.data: Local only.
screens.actions: Typing filters locally.
screens.notes: The field is drawn inside the scroll view to match the prototype; native .searchable places it under the large title.

screens.title: Screen 12 — Categorized results
screens.swiftUI: List with a Section per category (Songs, Albums, Artists, Playlists). Debounce input ≈ 150–250 ms (assumption). Use normalized fields for case/diacritic-insensitive matching.
screens.data: NSFetchRequest per entity (title/artist/album/name CONTAINS[cd]); must stay responsive at several thousand tracks (spec §5).
screens.actions: Song row → play (queue = visible song results). Album/Artist/Playlist rows push details.
screens.notes: Prototype caps song results at 6; real UI should paginate or offer “See All”.

screens.title: Screen 13 — Settings
screens.swiftUI: List(.insetGrouped) with sections MUSIC LIBRARY / PLAYBACK / STORAGE / ABOUT. Toggle for Resume Playback. Destructive text row for Clear Artwork Cache with a confirmation alert.
screens.data: UserDefaults for toggles; ArtworkCache size from disk; version from Bundle.main.
screens.actions: Music Folders → 14. Rescan Library → scan sheet (15). Library Statistics, Playback Preferences, Supported Audio Formats push simple lists.
screens.notes: Spec §7 requires restoring last queue/position WITHOUT auto-playing; define “Resume Playback” as “restore last queue” (assumption). No account/cloud/networking rows.

screens.title: Screen 14 — Manage music folders
screens.swiftUI: List(.insetGrouped) of sources (folder.fill, name, “N songs” or status), “Add Folder…” and “Rescan All” rows, EditButton for delete controls. Each row also has a contextMenu: Rescan, Remove from Library.
screens.data: MusicSource: displayName, bookmark data, status (ok | needsReconnect | unavailable), trackCount.
screens.states: populated; editing; one source unavailable (“Old iPod Backup” shown). The app-owned Documents/Music source should also appear as a row.
screens.actions: Add Folder → UIDocumentPickerViewController (system UI). Remove → alert → removes from library only.
screens.notes: The picker sheet in the interactive prototype only mocks the system document picker.

screens.title: Screen 15 — Scanning progress
screens.swiftUI: .sheet with a simple view: “Scanning Music”, current path (truncate head/middle, caption), ProgressView(value:), two counters (“Files discovered”, “Songs indexed”), Cancel button. Drive from LibraryScanner progress (AsyncStream / @Published); Cancel cancels the Task.
screens.data: ScanProgress{ currentPath, filesDiscovered, tracksIndexed, fraction? }. Use an indeterminate ProgressView if the total is unknown.
screens.states: running; cancelled; finished; finished with errors (S4).
screens.actions: Cancel → stops the scan; keep already-indexed results (assumption).
screens.notes: Numbers/path are placeholders. “.flac” is sample text only; FLAC support is unverified (spec §6).

screens.title: State variants — track rows (available, playing, unavailable, unsupported)
screens.swiftUI: Row view takes a TrackAvailability enum { available, unavailable(reason), unsupportedFormat }. Unavailable/unsupported rows are dimmed (≈0.4 opacity on artwork/title) with a secondary-colored reason; they stay in playlists and favorites (spec §4.7, §9). Tapping shows an alert (S3) instead of playing.
screens.data: Track.availability stored in Core Data; set by the scanner when file/bookmark access fails; re-evaluated on rescan.
screens.states: available · currently playing · unavailable (reconnect needed) · unsupported format
screens.actions: Tap on unavailable/unsupported → alert S3 or S2.
screens.notes: Reason copy is a suggestion.

screens.title: State variants — source needs reconnect
screens.swiftUI: The source row shows a warning status; tapping presents this alert. “Choose Folder” re-opens UIDocumentPickerViewController (directoryURL hint = last known URL) and replaces the stale bookmark. Do not remove the source or its playlists/favorites automatically.
screens.data: MusicSource.status = needsReconnect when bookmark resolution is stale/denied.
screens.actions: Choose Folder → picker → rebind bookmark → rescan that source.
screens.notes: Alert copy is a suggestion.

screens.title: State variants — unsupported / unplayable file alert
screens.swiftUI: Alert(title: "Can’t Play “<title>”", message: "This file’s format isn’t supported on this device.", OK). On repeated decoder failure advance per queue policy (spec §7: unavailable files and decoder errors).
screens.data: Decoder failure from AudioEngine → PlaybackCoordinator error state.
screens.actions: OK dismisses; coordinator skips or stops per rules.
screens.notes: Which formats actually fail is unverified; see CODEC_SUPPORT.md (to be produced).

screens.title: State variants — scan finished with skipped files
screens.swiftUI: Final state of the scan sheet when some files could not be read: counts for added and skipped, a “View Skipped Files” row (List of path + reason), Done button.
screens.data: ScanResult{ added, updated, skipped:[{path, reason}] }.
screens.actions: Done dismisses; View Skipped Files pushes a list.
screens.notes: Counts are placeholders.

screens.title: State variants — New Playlist name prompt
screens.swiftUI: iOS 15 SwiftUI alerts cannot host a TextField (added in iOS 16). Use a UIAlertController bridge, or a small .sheet with a TextField and Cancel/Save.
screens.data: Creates Playlist(kind: user, name) — empty until songs are added.
screens.actions: Save → opens the new (empty) playlist details.
screens.notes: Visual is the native UIAlertController look.
